cards.name: Overgrown
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to the highest [threat] location in the staging area without a copy of Overgrown attached. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached location gets +1 [threat] and gains 'Immune to player card effects.'")

cards.name: Territorial Ape
cards.text: Territorial Ape gets +X [threat] and + X [attack], where X is the [threat] of the active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if a location was explored this round).

cards.name: Forest Clearing
cards.text: Forced: When Forest Clearing is explored, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, add that enemy to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard an attachment you control.

cards.name: Stampeding Oliphaunt
cards.text: Doomed 1.

cards.name: Pit Trap
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to a location, if the active location's printed [threat] is equal to or greater than the attached enemy's remaining hit points, the engaged player adds Pit Trap and attached enemy to the victory display.

cards.name: Strangling Python
cards.text:
Surge.
Forced: After Strangling Python damages a character, attach it to that character. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached character cannot ready.")

cards.name: Mumak Trail
cards.text: While Mumak Trail is the active location, it gains: "Response: When Mumak Trail leaves play as an explored location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Wild Mumak and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck."

cards.name: Giant Centipede
cards.text: Forced: After Giant Centipede damages a character, treat that character's text box as if it were blank until the end of the round (except for Traits).
cards.shadow: Shadow: Treat the defending character's text box as blank until the end of the round.

cards.name: Biting Insects
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player discards a random card from his hand and assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the discarded card's cost.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a random card from your hand and assign X damage among characters you control. X is the discarded card's cost.

cards.name: The Savage South
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player discards the top 5 cards of his deck. Each player discards each card he controls that shares a title with any of the 5 cards he just discarded.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, return attacking enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Welcome to the Jungle
cards.text: Setup: Set each copy of Wild Mumak and each Capture objective aside, out of play. Each player adds 1 different location to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Forced: After the active location leaves play as an explored location, shuffle 1 set aside Wild Mumak into the encounter deck. The players cannot advance unless the number of Wild Mumak in play is equal to the number of players.

cards.name: Dense Jungle
cards.text: Forced: When Dense Jungle is explored, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a location, add that location to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a random card from your hand.

cards.name: Poisoned Spear
cards.text: Response: After the players quest successfully, the engaged player discards the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card's [threat] is equal to or greater than the attached enemy's remaining hit points, add Poisoned Spear and attached enemy to the victory display.

cards.name: Terrible Fever
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove a hero from the quest and attach Terrible Fever to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: At the end of the round, deal 1 damage to attached character.")
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character cannot ready until the end of the round.

cards.name: Harad Tiger
cards.text: Cannot be optionally engaged.

cards.name: Jungle Trail
cards.text: While Jungle Trail is the active location, each location in the staging area gets -1 [threat].Travel: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck to travel here.

cards.name: Guardians of the Jungle
cards.text: The great apes of the jungle gather in the trees around you. They shadow your steps and slow your progress.

cards.name: Horse-hair Lasso
cards.text: Response: After the attached enemy is dealt any amount of damage, the engaged player shuffles his deck and discards the top card. If the discarded card's cost is equal to or greater than the attached enemy's remaining hit points, add Horse-hair Lasso and attached enemy to the victory display.

cards.name: Wild Mumak
cards.text:
Indestructible.
 Immune to player card effects. Cannot take more than 3 damage each round.

cards.name: Noose of Vines
cards.text: Response: After a character defends an attack against the attached enemy, if the defending character has more remaining hit points than the attached enemy, add Noose of Vines and attached enemy to the victory display.

cards.name: Capture the Mumakil
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player attaches 1 random set-aside Capture objective to a Wild Mumak in play.
cards.back_text: Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if there is no active location, reveal an additional encounter card this phase. This stage cannot be defeated while there are any Capture objectives in play. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.
